sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Do not freeze: C1 and C2 are only checked for QuantityValue shape, decimal datatype, Newton unit, and cardinality; the required numerical-tolerance readiness validation is still missing. Add tolerance-based result checks for both brashIceResistanceCoefficientC1 and brashIceResistanceCoefficientC2 in their original QuantityValue domains, with tolerance scaled from the expected formula result rather than the reported value, while preserving the IA Super and bulbousBowPresent=false applicability branch, exactly one controlled iceClass and boolean bulbousBowPresent, and strictly positive B, L, and T checks.
